format: WSDC Registry Events age-based contests (Juniors, Sophisticated, Masters)

source.edition: Version 2026.1C (page footers; the file name says 2026.1B)
source.section: Definitions, Age-based Contests (PDF p3); 3.1.3 and 3.1.3.a (PDF p10)
source.quote_free_summary: Age-based contests use age at the close of the event: Juniors under 18, Sophisticated 35 or older, Masters 50 or older. Age-based Jack and Jill contests must be open to all skill levels who meet the age requirement.

requirement: Competition OS does not calculate or verify this age rule. For initial activation the organizer verifies age-division eligibility and the decision is recorded (who, when, outcome, reason code). WSDC Junior contests cannot be entered through Competition OS while OD-02 prohibits competitors under 18.

tests.name: a waiver never clears an age-restricted entry
refuses a waiver on an age-restricted division, a wrong reason, and a missing reason

enforcement_point: Organizer action and operational gate as for NDCA. No automated age calculation exists.
interpretation_notes: OD-03 Option C. WSDC reference date is the close of the event, unlike UCWDC and NDCA. A WSDC Junior contest conflicts with OD-02 (Juniors are under 18 by definition); the owner decided OD-02 applies to all event types. Whether an 18-or-older minimum is compatible with a Registry Event being open to everyone is an owner/organizer question (see WSDC-OD02-MIN-AGE-PUBLISHED).
applicable_event_versions: Version 2026.1C (page footers; the file name says 2026.1B)
